questions.q:
With reference to the Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin), consider the following statements:
1. It guarantees 125 days of wage employment per rural household in a year.
2. Like MGNREGA, it requires the Centre to bear the entire cost of unskilled wages.
3. States may notify a pause of up to 60 days in aggregate during peak sowing and harvest seasons.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The scheme, which replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026, is a CSS funded 60:40 (90:10 for NE and Himalayan States), whereas the Centre paid all unskilled wages under MGNREGA. It retains the 15-day unemployment allowance and plans works through Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans linked to PM GatiShakti.
questions.s: SRI notes B1 (CA June 2026, Shankar pp. 46-48)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Critics describe VB-G RAM G as a supply-driven scheme, unlike the demand-driven MGNREGA.
Statement-II: Works under VB-G RAM G are pre-planned through Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans tied to local development maps.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I. Under MGNREGA a worker's demand created the obligation to provide work; under the new scheme works flow from pre-approved plans and State budgets, which critics such as the MGNREGA Sangharsh Morcha say dilutes the right to work, especially if a State delays its 40% share.
questions.s: SRI notes B1 (CA June 2026, Shankar pp. 46-48)

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs relating to PMAY-Gramin:
Feature : Provision
1. Minimum house size : 25 sq m
2. Unit assistance in plain areas : Rs 1.2 lakh
3. Toilet support : Rs 12,000 under Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin
4. Identification of beneficiaries : Census 2011 houselisting data
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Beneficiaries come from the housing-deprivation data of the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011, verified by the Gram Sabha and geo-tagged on Awaas+. Hilly and NE areas get Rs 1.3 lakh, and 90-95 days of rural-employment wages are added. The target is 4.95 crore houses by 2029.
questions.s: SRI notes B1 (CA Apr 2026, Vision pp. 104-106)

questions.q:
Under PMAY-Gramin, a household is automatically excluded if it has which of the following?
1. A Kisan Credit Card with a limit of Rs 50,000 or more
2. A member earning more than Rs 15,000 a month
3. A motorised two-wheeler
4. A motorised three- or four-wheeler
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: A motorised three- or four-wheeler excludes a household, but a two-wheeler does not. Other automatic exclusions include a government employee in the family, an income- or professional-tax payer, 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land (5 acres unirrigated), a registered non-farm enterprise and mechanised farm equipment.
questions.s: SRI notes B1 (CA Apr 2026, Vision p. 104)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding DAY-NRLM:
1. It is implemented in all States and Union Territories, including Delhi and Chandigarh.
2. A NITI Aayog evaluation found that only about 15% of SHGs had started group enterprises.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 2 is correct; the mission runs everywhere except Delhi and Chandigarh. The evaluation, done by Sambodhi for NITI Aayog's DMEO, found that only 3.8% of members accessed the Community Enterprise Fund and many SHGs split revolving funds for consumption. The mission covers about 10 crore households in 91 lakh SHGs.
questions.s: SRI notes B1 (CA June 2026, Shankar pp. 48-49)

questions.q:
With reference to the Atal Pension Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. Bank account holders aged 18 to 40 years can join.
2. Income-tax payers are not eligible.
3. It is administered by PFRDA under the NPS architecture.
4. The Centre co-contributes for every subscriber who joins now.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. The government co-contribution (50% or Rs 1,000 a year for five years) applied only to those who joined between June 2015 and March 2016. APY, a Central Sector scheme under the Finance Ministry, gives a guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000-5,000 from 60 and has been extended to 2030-31.
questions.s: SRI notes B2 (CA Jan 2026, Vision p. 97)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the e-Shram portal:
1. It was developed by the National Informatics Centre for the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
2. Registration on it automatically enrols a worker in the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct. e-Shram is a database: registering does not by itself give insurance, which needs separate enrolment (one of its limitations). Since October 2024 it works as a one-stop solution linking 15 schemes, including PMSBY, PMJJBY and PM-SYM; it had 31.89 crore registrations by August 2026, 54.28% women.
questions.s: SRI notes B2 (CA Aug 2026, Shankar pp. 78-81)

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Scheme : Feature
1. NPS Vatsalya : Pension account for minors that converts to a regular NPS account at 18
2. Unified Pension Scheme : Assured pension for central staff with at least 10 years of service
3. National Social Assistance Programme : Launched in 2005 along with MGNREGA
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 1 and 2 are correct. NSAP dates from 1995 and covers old-age, widow and disability pensions and family benefit, with over 2.92 crore central beneficiaries in 2026. NPS Vatsalya (2024) and the Unified Pension Scheme (April 2025, an option under NPS) are both run under PFRDA's framework.
questions.s: SRI notes B2 (CA Aug 2026, Shankar pp. 79-80)

questions.q: 'NPS Vatsalya', launched by PFRDA in 2024, is
o: a pension account opened for minors that converts into a regular NPS account at 18
a guaranteed pension for anganwadi workers
a pension top-up for widows under the National Social Assistance Programme
a voluntary pension scheme for street vendors
questions.e: Parents open NPS Vatsalya for a child, and it becomes a normal NPS account at 18. Related products: the Unified Pension Scheme (April 2025) is an option under NPS giving central staff an assured, inflation-linked pension after at least 10 years' service, and NSAP gives old age, widow and disability pensions.
questions.s: SRI notes B2 (CA May 2026)

questions.q:
With reference to PM SVANidhi, consider the following statements:
1. It is implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.
2. The first working-capital loan is up to Rs 50,000.
3. Timely repayment earns an interest subsidy of 7%.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 3 is correct. The scheme belongs to the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, with the Department of Financial Services. Loans rise from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 and Rs 50,000, and vendors who repaid the second loan can get a credit card of up to Rs 30,000. Digital payments earn cashback of up to Rs 1,600.
questions.s: SRI notes B3 (CA Jan 2026, Vision p. 98)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding Samagra Shiksha:
1. At the State level it is implemented through a State Implementation Society.
2. Its Project Approval Board is headed by the Union Minister of Education.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct. The Project Approval Board is headed by the Secretary, Department of School Education and Literacy; the Governing Council is headed by the Minister. Samagra Shiksha (2018) merged SSA, RMSA and Teacher Education and hosts NIPUN Bharat, NISHTHA and PARAKH; it was extended to 30 Sept 2026 pending 16th FC approval.
questions.s: SRI notes B4 (CA May 2026, Vision pp. 124-125)

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs relating to PM POSHAN:
Item : Detail
1. Primary classes : 450 kcal and 12 g protein per meal
2. Upper primary classes : 700 kcal and 20 g protein per meal
3. Tithi Bhojan : Community provides special meals on festivals and occasions
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: All three pairs are correct. The scheme evolved from the National Programme of Nutritional Support to Primary Education (1995) to the Mid-Day Meal Scheme (2004) and PM POSHAN (2021). It is a Ministry of Education CSS, now also covering Balvatika, with mandatory social audits.
questions.s: SRI notes B4 (CA May 2026, Vision pp. 125-126)

questions.q:
With reference to PM-Vidyalaxmi, consider the following statements:
1. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme with 60:40 funding.
2. It gives 3% interest subvention on education loans to students whose family income is up to Rs 4.5 lakh a year.
3. Loans above Rs 7.5 lakh under it require collateral.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: None is correct. PM-Vidyalaxmi is a Central Sector scheme; its 3% subvention is for family income up to Rs 8 lakh (full interest subsidy up to Rs 4.5 lakh is the older PM-USP CSIS); and all its loans are collateral- and guarantor-free, backed by NCGTC. It covers 1,425 NIRF-based institutions, with Canara Bank running the portal.
questions.s: SRI notes B4 (CA July 2026, Vision pp. 88-89)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: PM-USP CSIS gives full interest subsidy on education loans for students with family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh.
Statement-II: Institutions under PM-Vidyalaxmi are selected on the basis of NIRF rankings.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both statements are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I; they describe two different schemes. PM-Vidyalaxmi supplements PM-USP CSIS and the Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Education Loans, extending partial subvention to families earning up to Rs 8 lakh in quality institutions.
questions.s: SRI notes B4 (CA July 2026, Vision p. 89)

questions.q: Under the new pattern, an Eklavya Model Residential School is to be set up in every block that has
o: more than 25% ST population and at least 10,000 tribal persons
at least 50,000 tribal persons, irrespective of their share
more than 50% ST population, irrespective of numbers
more than 50% ST population and at least 20,000 tribal persons
questions.e: The criterion is more than 50% ST population and at least 20,000 tribal persons (Census 2011). EMRS began in 2018-19 to give education on par with Navodaya Vidyalayas; 288 older schools funded under Article 275(1) grants are being upgraded, for a total target of 728 schools serving about 3.5 lakh students.
questions.s: SRI notes B4 (CA Feb 2026, Shankar pp. 20-22)

questions.q:
With reference to POSHAN Abhiyaan and Mission Poshan 2.0, consider the following statements:
1. POSHAN Abhiyaan was launched on 8 March 2018.
2. Mission Poshan 2.0 subsumed Anganwadi Services, the Scheme for Adolescent Girls and POSHAN Abhiyaan.
3. PM POSHAN, the school-meal scheme, is a component of Mission Poshan 2.0.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. PM POSHAN is a separate Ministry of Education scheme, while Poshan 2.0 belongs to the Ministry of Women and Child Development. Poshan 2.0 tools include the Poshan Tracker (2021), Navchetana (0-3 years), Aadharshila (3-6 years) and the 2026 Home Visit Scheduler.
questions.s: SRI notes B5 (CA Apr 2026, Shankar pp. 38-41)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK):
1. It covers children from birth to 18 years.
2. Its '4Ds' are defects at birth, diseases, deficiencies and drug dependence.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct; the fourth D is developmental delays, including disabilities. Launched in February 2013 under the National Health Mission, RBSK 2.0 covers 38 conditions and adds mental health and NCD risks. Screening happens at delivery points, Anganwadis and schools, with District Early Intervention Centres for treatment.
questions.s: SRI notes B5 (CA May 2026, Vision pp. 126-127)

questions.q:
With reference to the digital tools of the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, consider the following statements:
1. eSushrut@Clinic, a hospital management system for small facilities, was developed by NIC.
2. The National Health Claims Exchange links insurers, hospitals and regulators to speed up claims.
3. BODH, launched in 2026, requires hospitals to pool raw patient data in a central database for training AI.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 2 is correct. eSushrut@Clinic was developed by C-DAC, an R&D body under MeitY. BODH uses federated learning, so models are trained without exposing raw patient data, in keeping with ABDM's privacy-by-design rule that records stay with the provider. SAHI, also of 2026, is the strategy for AI in healthcare.
questions.s: SRI notes B5 (CA July 2026, Shankar pp. 35-37)

questions.q:
With reference to PM-AJAY, consider the following statements:
1. It merged the PM Adarsh Gram Yojana, Special Central Assistance to the Scheduled Castes Sub Plan and the Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana.
2. Its cost is shared between the Centre and States in the ratio 60:40.
3. A village qualifies for the Adarsh Gram component if more than 40% of its people are SCs and its population is at least 500.
4. At least 15% of grants to States are for income-generating schemes for SC women.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1, 3 and 4 are correct. PM-AJAY is a CSS but fully funded by the Centre; States may add their own money. Each Adarsh Gram gets Rs 20 lakh to saturate 50 indicators in 10 domains. The scheme draws on Articles 46 and 38(2), and its continuation for 2026-31 has been proposed.
questions.s: SRI notes B6 (CA July 2026, Vision pp. 87-88)

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs relating to tribal welfare:
Scheme : Feature
1. PM-JANMAN : Time-bound saturation of PVTG households
2. Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan : 25 interventions by 25 ministries
3. PM Janjatiya Vikas Mission : Implemented through TRIFED
4. SCA to Tribal Sub-Scheme : Began in 2017
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 1 and 3 are correct. Dharti Aaba brings 25 interventions from 17 ministries to 63,843 tribal villages. SCA to TSS began in 1977-78 as SCA to the Tribal Sub-Plan and was renamed in 2017 when Plan and non-Plan spending merged. PM-JANMAN saturates PVTG habitations within three years.
questions.s: SRI notes A3, B6 (CA Feb 2026, Shankar pp. 20-22)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding minor forest produce (MFP):
1. The Forest Rights Act, 2006 excludes bamboo from the definition of minor forest produce.
2. Under the PM Janjatiya Vikas Mission, MSP has been notified for 87 MFP items.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 2 is correct; the FRA defines MFP as all non-timber forest produce of plant origin and expressly includes bamboo. PESA, 1996 gives ownership of MFP to Gram Sabhas and Panchayats. By July 2026 there were 4,172 Van Dhan Vikas Kendras linking 12.48 lakh tribals.
questions.s: SRI notes B6 (CA Aug 2026, Shankar pp. 84-86)

questions.q:
With reference to the Jal Jeevan Mission, consider the following statements:
1. It was launched in 2014.
2. It is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
3. It is a Central Sector scheme.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: None is correct. JJM was launched in 2019 by the Ministry of Jal Shakti as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aiming at a tap connection for every rural home at 55 litres per person per day; it has been extended to December 2028. Coverage rose from 16.7% to about 81.8%, but the 2024 assessment found only 76% of connections functional.
questions.s: SRI notes B7 (CA Mar 2026, Vision pp. 91-92)

questions.q:
With reference to the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. It is implemented by the Ministry of Power.
2. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
3. It aims to install rooftop solar in one crore households.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 3 is correct. The scheme (2024) belongs to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy and is a Central Sector scheme. It offers up to 300 free units a month, subsidies up to Rs 78,000 and collateral-free loans at about 7% for systems up to 3 kW, with one Model Solar Village per district.
questions.s: SRI notes B7 (CA Feb 2026, Vision p. 104)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding tribal development funding:
1. Under the Development Action Plan for Scheduled Tribes, 41 ministries and departments earmark part of their scheme budgets for ST development.
2. Grants under the proviso to Article 275(1) are meant to raise the level of administration in Scheduled Areas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are correct. Article 275(1) grants run as a Special Area Programme with 100% central funding. NSTFDC, set up in 2001 as a section 8 company, lends to ST entrepreneurs, and Tribal Research Institutes get central support for research and training.
questions.s: SRI notes B6 (CA Feb 2026, Shankar pp. 20-22)

questions.q:
With reference to the funding of Centrally Sponsored Schemes after the 2016 rationalisation, consider the following statements:
1. Core schemes are usually shared 60:40 between the Centre and most States.
2. The 90:10 pattern applies to the North-Eastern States and to Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Jammu and Kashmir.
3. Optional schemes are shared 50:50 for most States.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: All three are correct; UTs without a legislature get 100% central funding, and optional schemes are 80:20 for NE and Himalayan States. The system came from a NITI Aayog Sub-Group of Chief Ministers (2015) and Budget 2016-17, which also tied scheme approval to the Finance Commission cycle.
questions.s: SRI notes A2 (static)

questions.q: Which one of the following is not among the six 'Core of the Core' Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
o: Umbrella scheme for development of Scheduled Castes
questions.e: Core of the Core covers social protection and inclusion: the rural employment guarantee (MGNREGA, now VB-G RAM G), NSAP, and umbrella schemes for SCs, STs, minorities and other vulnerable groups. JJM is a Core scheme with 60:40 funding (90:10 for NE and Himalayan States).
questions.s: SRI notes A2 (static)
